# Aurelia Hotel & Suites

> An intimate boutique luxury hotel and residential retreat located on the Champs-Élysées in Paris, France.

## Overview
Aurelia Hotel & Suites pairs classic French neoclassical architecture with modern luxury. The property features 6 signature handcrafted guest rooms and suites, tranquil interior courtyard gardens, Michelin-inspired dining, and 24-hour dedicated concierge service.

- Website: https://aureliahotel.com
- Location: 124 Avenue des Champs-Élysées, 75008 Paris, France
- Telephone: +33 1 42 68 55 00
- Email: reservations@aureliahotel.com
- Powered by: MAKAW (https://makaw.me)

## Accommodations
- Deluxe King Room: Handcrafted king bed, Italian linens, rainfall shower, garden courtyard view.
- Executive Suite: Expansive sitting salon, dedicated executive writing desk, artisan espresso bar.
- Prestige Terrace Room: Private sun-drenched balcony overlooking historic Parisian rooftops.
- Presidential Suite: Deep-soaking whirlpool bath, 24-hour butler care, formal dining salon.
- Junior Garden Suite: Ground-floor sanctuary with direct access to private botanical pathways.
- Ambassador Residence: Two-bedroom luxury residence with curated contemporary artwork.

## Amenities & Services
- 24-Hour Multilingual Concierge
- Fine Dining & Evening Wine Lounge
- Heated Courtyard Relaxation Pool
- In-Suite Spa & Wellness Treatments
- Private Chauffeur & Airport Transfers
